pages.text: SYN Business Review compares fund performance over the past year. Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products. The Ndovu Equity Fund charged 2.7 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 5,000. The Pweza Money Market Fund charged 1.6 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 5,000.

The Tembo Equity Fund charged 2.6 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 1,000. The Swala Bond Fund charged 1.9 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 5,000. The Duma Equity Fund charged 2.5 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 5,000. The Zuri Bond Fund charged 2.3 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 500.
